lever: Vitamin C-rich foods with iron-containing meals
intervention: Eating vitamin C-rich fruit or vegetables in the same meal as plant sources of iron
summary: Vitamin C in the same meal helps the body absorb iron from plant foods. In single-meal studies the effect is large, but across a normal mixed diet it is much smaller, and studies haven't shown a clear rise in ferritin from this alone.
whyThisGrade: Strong effect in short studies of single meals
Much smaller effect across a whole diet
Little direct evidence that it raises ferritin over months
